title: Find the 4 bugs in the QA Lab API
summary: The public API has a bug mode. Turn it on with ?scenario=bug, compare it with the correct mode and report every bug you can prove.
start: Call each endpoint twice: once as is and once with ?scenario=bug.
For every difference, write what you sent, what came back and what the contract says should come back.

solution.title: Missing user answers 200
solution.why: Clients that branch on the status code treat the error as a success.

solution.title: Created user loses fields
solution.actual: 201 with telefone and cargo as empty strings
solution.why: The request succeeds, so the data loss only shows up later.

solution.title: DELETE says yes but deletes nothing
solution.why: A status-only assertion passes; the side effect has to be checked.

solution.title: Health check hides a dead database
solution.expected: A non-healthy status when a dependency is down
solution.why: Monitors that only read status never alert.
